authority: Independent engineering specification review only; not a task proof, run outcome, implementation acceptance or feasibility qualification.

findings.concrete_case: An admitted source has a valid ordinary goal, but an optional generated correspondence theorem fails elaboration. Existing run_build compiles the entire goal and aborts its failure before candidate proof checking, so a direct embedding would turn unavailable authoring support into a required base failure.
findings.issue: Embedding optional readable definitions/correspondence in the required generated goal has no frozen staging, fallback, or acceptance-selection algorithm.
findings.required_resolution: Freeze a two-phase optional probe and promotion rule: which CHECKED entry blocks enter the goal, how unsupported/rejected/view-only infrastructure failures restore the original goal/library, how the final checked-entry inventory is selected deterministically, and what acceptance does when a proof transitively uses support that cannot be regenerated. Include view-only versus base input-mutation/infrastructure severity and stopping cases.

findings.concrete_case: A readable-view-manifest.json sidecar is replaced or deleted after acceptance while existing published goal/module/build/evidence files stay intact. The current verify_accepted path does not read that sidecar; adding a new certificate field directly also fails the current additionalProperties=false schema.
findings.issue: The explicit readable manifest is specified but its authoritative acceptance/evidence/closure binding path and schema/version are not.
findings.required_resolution: Choose and freeze the authoritative manifest reference location, canonical exact field set, schema/version changes if needed, published artifact inventory, verify/rebuild and closure checks. Specify generation order without goal/manifest self-hash cycles and which execution-record fields are bound but excluded from deterministic A/B equality. Include every renderer/support source in registered verifier identity unconditionally when executed.

findings.concrete_case: For a two-parameter helper, compileFunction.run receives Env in declaration order but its body is compiled under params.reverse. A curried readable helper cannot be applied to one Env in the stated RunEquals formula without an explicit conversion layer. Embedding the same relative namespace block under VeriSlopBridgeGoal can also change fully qualified declaration references and hashes.
findings.issue: Declared-order parameter denotations and the Env-facing readable_run interface are not given exact signatures; helper correspondence/lookup statements and standalone-versus-embedded namespace mapping are also unspecified.
findings.required_resolution: Freeze canonical shape and Env-facing entry/helper signatures, any declared-order curried interface, the single reversal boundary, helper lookup/RunEquals laws, and qualified naming/expected expression mapping for standalone and embedded blocks. Do not compare identical block bytes as a substitute for declaration identity.

findings.concrete_case: An unused support declaration outside EdgeProp can carry an axiom, unsafe/unresolved dependency, or accepted-reference call while the edge theorem has unchanged allowed axioms. Current _audit checks candidate-module axiom declarations and the edge transitive axiom set, but does not provide the required independent audit of every newly generated goal support declaration.
findings.issue: The design needs a closed exhaustive support-declaration audit and a mechanically testable source-only input/dependency boundary, rather than relying on the existing edge audit.
findings.required_resolution: Freeze the expected complete declaration inventory and permitted compiler auxiliaries, exact type/body and universe checks, kinds/safety/unresolved references, transitive axioms, and permitted readable-body constants. Supply a narrow source/signature/nominal-registry input object rather than a full GoalSpec carrying formulas. Add output-independence tests that vary accepted reference bodies and guarantees while source/signatures/registries are fixed, plus unused-support declaration mutations.

findings.category: feasibility unresolved, already acknowledged by design
findings.concrete_case: A small acyclic diamond helper graph is rendered with shared named calls, but checking equality to compiled helper closures may still expand dependent casts and helper bodies during one definitional-conversion step. Bounded renderer emission and a counted generation step do not by themselves bound proof-term or elaboration cost.
findings.issue: A finite efficient correspondence generator for the full 39-constructor registry is not yet described at the level needed to approve implementation scope, and view-only generation/elaboration budgets and status mapping are still deferred.
findings.required_resolution: Before implementation approval, freeze a constructor-to-correspondence rule/dependency matrix, helper reuse strategy and allowed closed administration reductions. Specify rendered/proof/IR node and byte ceilings, conversion/elaboration/kernel budgets, counting rules and optional status/reason mapping. Qualify hard generic branches first; a failed view must remain unavailable and cannot count as completed full coverage.

limits: Design feasibility is unestablished, as the design itself states. The findings specify engineering choices and checks to freeze; they do not propose task-specific proof repairs or authorize changes to the current frozen source.
scope: Sealed design, engineering note, design manifest and generic production APIs only. No retained task/formula/source/proof/corpus/stage artifacts were read for this review.
strengths: Compiler binder rules match the design: declared-order call arguments, reversed parameter body environment, list-fold item/accumulator, natural-fold accumulator/index and list-match tail/head.
Intrinsic Sum Result carriers, ordered product record carriers and original adapter wrappers/raw evaluation shapes agree with current APIs.

Universal exact equality, unchanged Refines/EdgeProp/transfer/coverage, optional support, no reference-body generation and no new trust are stated clearly. No soundness counterexample to those stated invariants was found.
Coverage is 39 of 41 current Expr constructors, with variant/matchVariant explicitly excluded. Any wording asserting all39 current constructors needs this scope correction.
validation_refinements: Add well-typed same-sort binder mutations: two parameters of the same sort, item and accumulator of the same sort, and Nat index/accumulator with distinct use. Current listed heterogeneous fixtures can reject swaps at typing alone, without demonstrating the universal equality gate catches semantically wrong yet typable views.
Define an explicit expected status/severity/result matrix for renderer-budget exhaustion, correspondence rejection, view-only tool failure, input mutation, and base verifier failure.
Audit every support theorem even when unused by an edge and every generated support declaration, and preserve the base declaration inventory on unavailable fallback.
